title: Google AI health coach to use Abbott glucose data
summary: Google and Abbott have announced a multiyear partnership to integrate Abbott's Lingo continuous glucose monitoring data into Google's AI-powered health coaching app. The Gemini-powered service will provide users with combined glucose trends alongside other personal health metrics for better metabolic health management.
problem_solved: Breaks down data silos by combining continuous glucose monitoring with AI-powered health insights for more holistic personal health tracking.
why_valuable: Enables proactive health management by giving users unified access to glucose data and AI-driven health recommendations in one platform.
